Spectroradiometer CS-2000/2000A
Product catalog summary
Overview: The CS-2000 and CS-2000A are high-end spectroradiometers designed for high accuracy and stability in measuring luminance and chromaticity. They are suitable for a wide range of applications, including display panels, small light sources, and distant lights.
Specifications: The spectroradiometers feature a wavelength range of 380 to 780 nm, with a resolution of 0.9 nm/pixel and a spectral bandwidth of 5 nm or less. They offer selectable measuring angles of 1°, 0.2°, and 0.1°, allowing for flexibility in measuring different light sources.
Measurement Capabilities: The CS-2000A can measure luminance from 0.0005 cd/m2 to 50M cd/m2, while the CS-2000 ranges from 0.003 cd/m2 to 500,000 cd/m2. Both models ensure minimal polarization error and high repeatability, with chromaticity accuracy of x: ±0.0015 and y: ±0.001.
Communication and Connectivity: The devices support RS-232C communication at a maximum of 115,200 bps and can be connected to PCs via USB. Wireless communication is possible with an RS-Bluetooth conversion adapter.
Software and Data Management: The CS-S10w Professional Edition software allows for data management, analysis, and evaluation. It supports various data formats and offers features like spectral graph display, chromaticity diagrams, and scotopic vision measurement.
Accessories and Options: Optional accessories include close-up lenses, ND filters, and a CCD camera adapter. Standard accessories include a USB cable, calibration certificates, and data management software.
Applications: The spectroradiometers are ideal for use as reference instruments in various industrial fields and can be used for evaluating projectors, LED, and EL lighting.
Safety and Compliance: Users are advised to read the instruction manual for safe operation. The instruments are compliant with relevant standards and certifications.
